core_obligations: The double complex (proof lines 2405-2414): take a bounded-below complex of injective O-modules I^bullet representing K and set A^{p,q} = a_{p,*} I^q_p; the horizontal arrows come from the augmentation Cech complex for modules, the vertical ones from the differentials of I^bullet; the rows are exact in positive degrees with degree-0 value a_* I^q, so the associated total complex computes Ra_*K by the double-complex resolution lemma.

The columns (lines 2416-2424): restriction to C_p is exact, so I_p^bullet represents K_p in D(C_p); the I_p^q are totally acyclic on C_p; hence the cohomology of the columns is the sheaves R^q a_{p,*} K_p by Leray's acyclicity lemma and the limp-acyclicity lemma.
Conclusion (lines 2424-2434): applying the first-quadrant spectral sequence lemma gives the spectral sequence in Mod(O_D) with E_1^{p,q} = R^q a_{p,*} K_p converging to R^{p+q} a_* K.
proof_roadmap: Build the double complex of pushed-forward injective values and identify its rows via the augmentation Cech complex.
Identify the column cohomology with R^q a_{p,*} K_p via exactness of restriction and total acyclicity.
Conclude with the first-quadrant spectral sequence lemma.
